name: layout-picker-previews
why: Bare `layout` (and ▦) cycled blind and nothing listed the layouts. `layout` opens a picker; moving the highlight previews the layout behind it (focus hides the art and the library), and Esc puts the original back. (74x30, so classic shows its art.)

name: layout-picker-previews-esc
why: Esc closes the picker and puts the layout you had back.

name: layout-picker-previews-enter
why: Enter keeps the previewed layout, through the same path as `layout <name>`.
